# proxmox_node_ceph_monitors (Data Source)

Lists Ceph monitors from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/mon`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_monitors" "m" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `monitors` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `ceph_version` (String)
- `host` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `quorum` (Boolean)
- `rank` (Number)
- `state` (String)
